claim_one_line: THE PUNCTURE CHARACTERS, banked PROVED (room for two; run as sealed at 3b8562a2 with the addendum 87f7b788; the records regenerated by the sealed code and every number of the first read-out reproduced). On the 80 fibre-direction covers M_{D,w} (2 <= ∣D∣ <= 12) of m004, m003, m136 and m135, the line's supply at the puncture characters (2,406,622 in 662,988 Galois orbits, every root of unity) is >= 1 at 483,692 orbits and >= 2 at 64,422, at most 5, read in routes W (exact), P (two primes, 3,376,190 reads) and T (483,692), with no disagreement. Proposition H (the quaternion line) holds on all ten (Z/2)^2 covers: the supply at the character cutting out the Q8 cover sums to 4 over the roots of unity, at most 2 where the monodromy moves Q8 and even where it fixes it. In Part F's readable scope (12,152 candidates, 501,792 readings, routes R and P4 agreeing at every one), 10,346 members: room min(capW, capL2) 0/1/2/3 at 938/3,816/3,736/1,856; room for two at 5,592, all on the silver pair; room three at 1,856 members on exactly four degree-8 covers (m135's D8.2-0-4.w1, D8.4-0-2.w4; m136's D8.2-0-4.w3, D8.4-0-2.w5), where sm:B1545's Corollary G excludes three at every class. So within the scope the silver pair's puncture characters carry no three; room for two is real and its class readings are the next sealed arc. 52,270 candidates out of scope stay OPEN. 0 of 19.
